name: Backrooms The Levels
detailed_description:
Immerse Yourself in a Unique Exploration Experience

Backrooms Levels is an immersive exploration game inspired by the phenomena of "liminal spaces," "found footage," and the eerie "Backrooms." There are no monsters chasing you or sudden jump scares. Instead, you will experience a constant sense of loneliness and disorientation, trapped in an endless world where every hallway and room hides a mystery revealed only through atmosphere and environment.

Explore. Listen. Feel.

This is not an action game, nor a traditional story with characters. It is a sensory experience where the environment itself is the true protagonist. From the very beginning, you are alone in an unknown world, with no instructions or dialogues to guide you. There is no visible interface to break the immersion, and instead of background music, ambient sounds create a deeply immersive atmosphere. The echoes in the rooms, the sound of water as you walk or swim, and the reverberations in enclosed spaces will make you feel as if you are truly there.

A World That Constantly Changes

As you explore and progress, you will notice that the environment never stays the same. Rooms subtly change, revealing parts of other levels. Each chapter presents unique locations with its own atmosphere, from vast flooded spaces to dark, narrow corridors that challenge your perception and play with your fears.

Freedom of Movement and Exploration Challenges

This game is not just about walking. You will need to use parkour skills to overcome obstacles, climb structures, and find alternative routes in environments designed to challenge your navigation skills. Some areas may feel like a labyrinth, and the only way to progress is by carefully observing your surroundings and listening to ambient sounds for guidance. Additionally, in certain sections, you can navigate a boat to explore areas inaccessible by foot.

Key Features:

🔹 Immersive exploration – Roam an open world or navigate through tight, claustrophobic spaces.
🔹 Oppressive atmosphere – Experience the unsettling fear of being lost in a space that defies logic.
🔹 No UI or dialogue – The story is told purely through the environment and sound.
🔹 Fluid movement – Use parkour skills to move freely and swim in aquatic environments. You can also control a boat in specific areas.
🔹 Dynamic environments – Each chapter features unique locations that constantly evolve.
🔹 Inspired by internet phenomena – Based on "liminal spaces," "found footage," and the mysterious "Backrooms."

If you are looking for a different kind of horror experience, where atmosphere and immersion are the key elements, Backrooms Levels will take you into the unknown. There is no escape—only exploration. How far will you go?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10+(64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460, 2.70GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2080 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU with Ray-Tracing support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10+ (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 3770 3.4GHz or AMD equivalent or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3080 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: No
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU with Ray-Tracing support
